rules.rescheduling: This includes changes of plan, illness, late arrival or any other reason. If we ever have to cancel your visit, we'll offer you a new time slot or day.

parking: Parking is a little tricky around here but Tesco car park is only a few feet away and you get 3 hours here to park or there is also the hildreds car park where you pay for parking and then we are on the high street (chip pan ally) before you get to Costa.
access: Wheelchair access if in a small wheel chair that can get through a normal main door also we have a small step on the main door.
